# routeros_routing_ospf_interface (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `area` (String) The OSPF area this interface belongs to.
- `interface` (String) Name of the interface.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___unset___` (String) <em>A set of fields that require setting/unsetting. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `address` (String) The local address OSPF is run on. It selects one of the addresses of the interface when more than one is configured.
- `auth` (String) Specifies the authentication method for the OSPF protocol messages.
- `auth_id` (Number) The key id used to calculate the message digest when MD5 or SHA authentication is enabled.
- `auth_key` (String, Sensitive) The authentication key to be used, it should match on all the neighbors of the network segment.
- `cost` (Number) Interface cost expressed as the link state metric.
- `dead_interval` (String) Specifies the interval after which a neighbor is declared dead.
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `hello_interval` (String) The interval between the HELLO packets that the router sends out this interface.
- `instance_id` (Number) The OSPF instance id carried in the packets sent out this interface.
- `passive` (Boolean) If enabled, then do not send or receive OSPF traffic on this interface, but still advertise the attached network.
<em>The correct value of this attribute may not be displayed in Winbox. Please check the parameters in the console!</em>
- `priority` (Number) Router's priority. Used to determine the designated router in a broadcast network.
- `retransmit_interval` (String) Time interval after which a lost link state advertisement will be resent.
- `transmit_delay` (String) Link-state transmit delay is the estimated time it takes to transmit a link-state update packet on the interface.
- `type` (String) The OSPF network type on this interface.
- `use_bfd` (Boolean) Whether to use the BFD protocol for faster connection state detection.
- `vlink_neighbor_id` (String) Specifies the router id of the neighbor which should be connected over the virtual link.
- `vlink_transit_area` (String) A non-backbone area the two routers have in common over which the virtual link will be established.

### Read-Only

- `bdr` (String) The router ID of the current backup designated router on this segment.
- `dr` (String) The router ID of the current designated router on this segment.
- `dynamic` (Boolean) Configuration item created by software, not by management interface. It is not exported, and cannot be directly modified.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `state` (String) The current OSPF interface state.
- `vlink_remote_address` (String) The address of the remote end of the established virtual link.
